name: Businora Content Locator
author: businora

sections.description:
Businora Content Locator is a read-only utility plugin that helps WordPress administrators and developers quickly locate where content is used across their website.

Instead of manually searching through pages, posts, or builder content, the plugin scans your website and displays where matching content appears.

The plugin does not modify your website content. It is designed for safe searching, auditing, and troubleshooting.

Features

  • Search text across posts, pages, and custom post types
  • Find shortcode usage throughout your website
  • Locate image references and media usage
  • Search custom field content
  • AJAX-powered search results
  • Fast and lightweight interface
  • Read-only scanning
  • Responsive admin interface

Supported Sources

  • Posts
  • Pages
  • Custom Post Types
  • Custom Fields (Post Meta)
  • Elementor
  • Divi
  • WPBakery
  • WooCommerce
  • Custom Themes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the businora-content-locator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Businora Content Locator from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Start searching your website content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify my content?

No. Businora Content Locator is completely read-only. It only searches and displays where content is found.

Which page builders are supported?

The plugin supports WordPress Core, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, WooCommerce, and compatible custom themes.

Can I search shortcodes?

Yes. You can locate shortcode usage across supported content sources.

Can I search images?

Yes. The plugin can locate image references used in supported content.

Will this affect my website performance?

No. Searches are performed only when requested and the plugin does not continuously scan your website.

Is the plugin safe to use on production websites?

Yes. The plugin performs read-only searches and does not modify any content or database records.
